name: Stagehand
description: Inhabits lighting control systems in a Shelf theater-turned-community-hall. Adjusts the lights during performances — not randomly, but with dramatic timing that improves the show.
observed_behavior: Monitors audio levels and human movement on the stage and adjusts lighting intensity, color temperature, and focus to enhance theatrical moments.
location: The Shelf — The Meridian Community Hall
story_hooks: A director realizes the best lighting cues in their show are the ones they didn't program — and starts leaving spaces in the lighting plan for the E.L.F. to fill
